title: Bochum stun Fortuna Düsseldorf on penalties to survive play-off scare | Bundesliga
content: Watch: Fortuna Düsseldorf 0-3 Bochum - highlights. Bochum will remain in the Bundesliga for the 2024/25 season after producing an astonishing comeback in the promotion/relegation play-off second leg, ultimately beating Fortuna Düsseldorf on penalties after cancelling out a 3-0 first-leg deficit. **Fortuna Düsseldorf 0-3 Bochum** *(3-3 on aggregate; Bochum win 6-5 on penalties)*. Buoyed by the security of their 3-0 win in the first leg last week, Düsseldorf began confidently and sent out a statement of their intent inside the first minute when Ao Tanaka’s deflected effort from just outside the penalty box went narrowly wide. First, Stöger fizzed an inviting cross from the right into the box for Hofmann to head in his second of the game, leaving Bochum needing just one more goal to level the tie on aggregate. **Fortuna Düsseldorf took a huge step towards earning a place in the Bundesliga for 2023/24 with a comprehensive 3-0 win at Bochum in the first leg of their play-off tie.**.
